proposal.summary: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) that allows an administrative user to bypass a database restriction on the query setting page and connect to an unintended database.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: Server-side request forgery vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

AV.quote: Server-side request forgery vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

PR.quote: A user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege may bypass the database restriction set on the query setting page, and connect to a user unintended database.

C.quote: A user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege may bypass the database restriction set on the query setting page, and connect to a user unintended database.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request reproduction steps, full exploit details, and confirmation of what database access or data exposure is possible; obtain affected configuration details and provide a patch or mitigation guidance restricting backend requests.

evidence_quotes.claim: Attacker privileges required and impact described
